title: Event
description: One status event POSTed by bench to /runs/{id}/events. The Job or process exit status stays the final authority.

sequence.description: Starts at 0 and grows by one per event, so the API can order and de-duplicate.

phase.description: Current phase while state is running during the load step, for example warmup or stage-2.

pipelineStep.description: The seven steps of the run pipeline.

reportedState.description: The lifecycle states bench can report. pending, launching and cancelled belong to the API's runner.
